# v2026.10.37

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.37.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.37.md).

This release covers **8 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Flow emails each invitation through Clerk, and the People page is cleaner. ([#192](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/192))
- The Invoices list gets a bulk action bar for ticked rows. ([#190](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/190))
- The invoice page shows a Linked card with the Seazona order and the Xero number. ([#184](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/184))
- Jobs board lanes stay in one row and scroll sideways. ([#188](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/188))
- A job's Fix box points to its Flow invoice, not to Xero. ([#189](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/189))
- A Flow server in a Replit workspace runs no background jobs. ([#187](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/187))

## Changes

- The invoice page shows a Linked card with the Seazona order and the Xero number. ([#184](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/184))
- The Invoices list gets a bulk action bar for ticked rows. ([#190](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/190))
- A click on the folded sidebar's empty space opens it. ([#193](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/193))
- Clerk emails each Flow invitation, and the People page is cleaner. ([#192](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/192))

## Fixes

- Jobs board lanes stay in one row and scroll sideways, not onto a second row. ([#188](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/188))
- A job's Fix box points to its Flow invoice and the case, not to Xero. ([#189](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/189))
- A Flow server in a Replit workspace runs no jobs and reports as "workspace". ([#187](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/187))
